results.name: Default deployment cells are pure, stable and do not seek a different unoccupied tile
Port defaults to its ocean tile when present and has a stable coast fallback otherwise
Setting an occupied deployment tile is legal and free of AP or resource cost
Deployment settings reject invalid facility, distance, terrain and ownership atomically
Setting deployment must support every queued and in-production model
New production cannot choose a model incompatible with the configured deployment tile
Production waits for owner turn then automatically deploys onto an empty configured cell
Blocked production enters FIFO inventory with a maximum of three
Moving the blocker automatically releases exactly one FIFO entry per transaction
A full queue retains a finished order, then uses the freed slot without losing FIFO
Changing to an empty compatible deployment cell immediately releases the FIFO head
Cross-player vacancy release preserves unit owner, grants zero AP, and resets on owner turn
Destroying a blocker releases its owner inventory after combat without a new counterattack
Hidden cross-player automatic deployment is not broadcast in human action logs
Automatic deployment events expose complete identifiers to the effect pipeline
Each shared deployment tile is allocated deterministically to one facility
Ruins, foundations and eliminated owners never release inventory
Rejected commands do not release waiting inventory or complete orders
Legacy manual deploy is retained but cannot cause a second output from that facility in the same action
Automatic output retains the 24 cap because inventory and orders are already reserved
Automatic movement capture consumes movement AP plus capture AP in one transaction
A move with only one AP reaches the building without granting a free capture
Traversed buildings are ignored; only the actual endpoint is captured
A collision captures an eligible actual stopping cell, not the unentered requested endpoint
Zero-step collisions do not auto-capture the unit current building or spend AP
Own and allied buildings are not automatically captured
All three states may automatically capture their reachable endpoint
Arriving at an enemy foundation captures it as a ruin and discards its old queue
Automatic HQ capture terminates play before unrelated waiting stock can spawn
Spawning onto a neutral building never grants an uncharged automatic capture
Configured cells, FIFO order and completed production survive save/restore without replay
Old save files lacking deployment fields read stable defaults and do not auto-release on restore
Save validation rejects configured cells with bad coordinates, range or queue terrain compatibility
Automatic AI output uses the selected difficulty without modifying human units
AI uses deployment settings with FIFO instead of legacy arbitrary manual deployment
AI does not repeat a blocked setting for the same head and turn or consult an unseen blocker
